trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. Everything is single-player and offline: no multiplayer, no DLC and no online trophy stands between you and the platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of Chapter 1 and unlocks automatically as you play the story — there is nothing special to do.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter ends once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It ends when you begin the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It ends after the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It ends when you complete the chapter's final mission, 'Starting From Zero'. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It pops at the very end of the story and cannot be missed — just play through to the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Breakfast Run' in Chapter 2. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'The Cartel Heist' in Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Child's Play' in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Headliners' in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory' in Chapter 5. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story (progress made during the story already counts). The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, finish 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions, and complete every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Nothing on the list is missable; everything can be done in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Track them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most come up naturally in the story and while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges are also where you raise Focus, and the gold medals are not too demanding.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Any win at each location counts — you do not need to win every race, just one per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations around Leonida, so pick the easiest ones and skip the rest.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games'): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (available from Chapter 1), or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. You must reach the end of a game — finishing all its levels once is enough; you do not need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest strand (Lucia only). It is marked automatically in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand. It is marked in Chapter 1 after 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' — look for the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwreck sites on the map; dive down, use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break': Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more strands are still being confirmed. Every strand stays available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars — the Zorrusso is delivered during the mission, then bring him the rest (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand (Jason only). It opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty' — purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Destroy enough labs ('Take Out Kitty Litter'), then Tyrone gives you 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs) and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. You can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each spot, and each character counts separately (+2 per spot). Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept'. It disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it is required, so do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel (Jason only). His strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' — Bret texts Jason and marks 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (collect it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), then marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals he requests back to him. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — collect a full set of one type to complete it, and do that three times.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with your phone (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — so any 100 count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports bike through traffic works well; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route because cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault missions, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Available after 'Coffee Break'. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the solid red heat level), wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix/Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs') — loot a few items and crack the back-room safe in each. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing traffic (R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. A busy road is the fastest way to rack up new models. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model scans, so this pops on the way. Track it under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted). It only lasts a few seconds, so buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle). Line up 5 criminals at a Gang Operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556; wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) and rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick, no alarm), find the safe-code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, grab the cash with your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag) and escape. Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his Payday Loans quests) to mark more vans. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then switch cars to break recognition. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 pop the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%. Each vault pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission ('That's Where The Money Is…') unlocks it — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map (52 areas). The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total (all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way). They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the ocean view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' to break in. Only the blue Banshee works — it is a GTA III easter egg. The trophy pops a moment after you drive away.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation). Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them for the safe. The 3 items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', but it is not missable — the robbery icon respawns, so you can return later for any item you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' (character switching). Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership, and always bring your partner along (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other trains too, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Profiles range from Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and the permanent Irredeemable (avoid that one — cops shoot on sight). Most of it happens passively while you play; if anything is left at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed. PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (Vice City, Little Cuba) — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. Check back for an update once the method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night (after 2 AM), alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods to find the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky); approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so be patient.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job (after the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'), so it comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they are the fastest way to burn through it. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (total $160,000). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone and you buy through it. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to earn the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each one adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' and 'Register' in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
